content: Isaac ampa akely atnyeneyel
INGKARTel Sarah renh arntarnt-arek, rarl Sarah renh ilek-angkwarr.
Abraham ampwanem irrek. Sarah-el awey akely atnyenek.
Abraham-el renh itnewek Isaac.
Arlta 8 ikwerel-antey renh artwilek, INGKARTelarl renh ilek-angkwarr.
Abraham aherrety 100 anenh.
Sarah angkek, “Akngeyel ayenh irrkngerney anthek. Ingkerrenhel awem, atharl awey akely atnyeneyel, rernem inkwerelhem arrpemarl.”
Rap angkek, “Ingwer-rnemel Abraham ilek, ‘Sarah-el awey aylpaty anthem,’ ra ikwer-rnem irrpelthirrenh. Lyert, ra ampwan aneyel, awey ikwerenh atnyeneyel.”
Abraham-el Hagar-then Ishmael-then irrenteyel
Isaac kel ilkwerrek. Ra kel amernant arlkwenh, aylpaty menty ipmek. Abraham-el tyenkerr ilkwa ikwer atnyenek.

Sarah-el awey Ishmael renh arek. Sarah-el alharlkwemel Abraham-ek angkek, “Ntwa warrkenh yanh Egypt-areny irrenta! Ampikw ikwerenh-then. Ayeng ilkelhey-angenh ampa Hagar ikwerenh-kety ngkweng-they ampwal-rnem inayntetyek. Ampa atyenhelant ampwal ngkwenh-rnem atnyenerl-ayntetyek, arntarnt-arayntetyek ngarl ilwem-kety.”
Abraham ahelirrek, Sarah-elarl renh irrentetyek-anem arrkernelhek.
Akngeyel Abraham renh ilek, “Menty arelh yanh-then ampa akely-then menty alpetyek tyarlewa, Sarah-elarl renh ilek-angkwarr. Isaac impen ngkwenhan. Ikwer-they akngerram-akngerrirreyenh arrpemarl.
Arelh warrkenh-kenh ampikw yanh menty-anem. Yanhan alerengkw ngkwenh arrpemarl. Ikwer-they akngerram-akngerrirreyenh arrpemarl.”
Abraham-el Hagar renh arranty kwaty-akert anthek amern-then, anpethel akngeynetyek. Hagar-then Ishmael-then irrentek-anem. Ratherr alpek, apmer Beersheba-angkwarr, arlpaw-angkwarr.
Kwaty kel ywerrek-anem. Hagar-el awey renh iwerl-alhek, lywenty-itwek.
Ra arleng-warl alhek, arrernelhemel, awey renh arekerr, ra ilwekarl-kety.
Akngeyel awey renh awek, rarl artnek. Akngey-kenh angel-el irrwerl-they arlkek, “Hagar, ilekek nga artneyel? Aterirrey-angenh. Akngeyel awek, awey rarl artnek.
Awey ngkwenh inerl-alha, renh arternpiletyek. Atha ngkwenh-rnem akngerram-akngerrileyenh.”
Akngey kwaty Hagar ikwer anayntelhilek. Ra kwaty ngenty arek. Hagar-el kwaty inpek arranty-warl, awey renh anthek, antywetyek.
Akngeyel awey renh arntarnt-arek. Ra ilkwerrek-anem. Ra apmer arlpawel anenh. Ra akaltyirrek pewenarrek.
Ra arlpawel anenh, rernem apmer renh itnewek Paran. Ingwer-ingeran amikw ikwerenhel anew inek ikwer, aleyak Egypt-areny. ...
